# Saffron of Kashmir

> Premium Kashmiri Mongra saffron, harvested in Pampore, Kashmir.

## Pages

- [Home](https://saffronofkashmir.com/): Products, ordering information, FAQ, and the brand story.
- [Products](https://saffronofkashmir.com/products): Full product catalogue. In stock: Royal Mongra 2g, Collector's Tin 5g and Heritage Reserve 10g. Out of stock: Kashmiri Kahwa Blend 100g. Coming soon: Saffron Honey 500 ml and Saffron Oil 15ml.
- [Recipes](https://saffronofkashmir.com/recipes): Tested saffron recipes: Kashmiri Kahwa, Zafrani Pulao, Kesar Doodh and Arabic Saffron Machboos.
- [Blog](https://saffronofkashmir.com/blogs): Guides on Mongra saffron grades, purity testing, Pampore heritage, Arabic cuisine, and research-backed health benefits.
